raw_blocks: Our innovations empower surgeons and improve patient outcomes while respecting the selfless gift of tissue donation.

From our roots as a Montana-based tissue bank to a recognized leader in advanced orthobiologics, Xtant Medical develops a comprehensive biologics portfolio supported by spinal implants systems that work seamlessly with our grafts.
3 Essential Elements for Superior Performance

Xtant Medical, a tissue bank and a developer of orthobiologics and spinal fixation systems. Our integrated capabilities in tissue processing and biologic innovation allow us to provide surgeons with scientifically engineered solutions for a wide range of procedures.

Xtant is a leading biologics company with 25 years of clinical success, offering a broad range of orthobiologic solutions. Our vertically integrated operations, from donor recovery to distribution, ensure unmatched quality, traceability, and consistency. With state-of-the-art processing and patented, clinically proven technology, Xtant delivers industry-leading biologics you can trust.
A complementary portfolio of cervical, thoraco-lumbar, and interbody spinal implant systems used in complex, deformity, and degenerative procedures.

Our cervical, thoracolumbar, and interbody systems are engineered to pair naturally with Xtant biologics, giving surgeons a single, reliable source for biologic and fixation needs without compromising choice or performance.
A Mission Rooted in Respect

Every graft begins with a selfless act of generosity. At Xtant Medical, we are privileged to receive the extraordinary gift of human tissue donation. Each decision we make—from donor screening to final delivery—honors the trust of donors and their families by ensuring the highest standards of safety, quality, and clinical performance.
At Xtant Medical, we recognize our duty to advance innovation made possible by the gift of donation. Every product reflects the precision, performance, and progress surgeons rely on.

Every year, Xtant Medical proudly observes National Donate Life Month and Blue & Green Day. This celebration is dedicated to raising awareness about the lifesaving impact of organ, eye, and tissue donors, while honoring those who have given the ultimate gift of life through donation.
Our mission is to honor the gift of donation, by allowing our patients to live as full and complete a life as possible.

Xtant Medical is a mission-driven organization dedicated to honoring the gift of donation. Headquartered in Montana, we unite the strength of science, the heart of purpose, and the agility of a vertically integrated business.

raw_blocks: Our mission is to honor the gift of donation by allowing our patients to live as full and complete a life as possible.

Headquartered in Montana, Xtant Medical combines the rigor of science with the heart of purpose. We started as a spin-off from Montana State University’s Center for Biofilm Engineering. We evolved into Xtant Medical, where today, we deliver a comprehensive biologics and fixation portfolio while staying true to our roots: honoring donors, serving patients, and innovating for the future. Our biologics are processed in a dedicated, state-of-the-art facility using patented technologies like BacteRinse™ to preserve essential growth factors while ensuring safety and clinical reliability. This focus allows us to honor every donor gift with the highest standards of quality and respect.
Through an effective Quality System, Xtant Medical prioritizes our commitment to our patients, our donors and donor families.

We aim to improve the quality of life for our patients by designing, manufacturing and distributing medical devices and human tissues for transplant that are safe, effective and meet the needs of our customers.
We honor the gift of donation by enhancing our core competencies and maximizing utilization of the gift.

Our vertically integrated tissue operations, spanning donor recovery, patented processing, and distribution, allow us to deliver grafts without compromising safety, quality, and clinical performance. Every product reflects our mission to honor the gift of donation and give patients the best chance for healing. At Xtant Medical, we recognize our duty to advance innovation made possible by the gift of donation. Every product reflects the precision, performance, and progress surgeons rely on.
Supported by decades of peer-reviewed data and fusion rates as high as 97.5%
Technologies like BacteRinse® preserve native growth factors and optimize handling
Solutions for a wide range of procedures, all backed by a single, reliable supply chain.
We offer a broad portfolio of biologic advancements that are shaping the medical field, and we’re proud to support innovations that make a meaningful difference in people’s lives.
Our vertically integrated operations ensure full control, from donor recovery through distribution we deliver consistent, high-quality allografts and advanced biologic graft options.

A naturally occurring blend of growth factors stabilized in native human collagen, OsteoFactor Pro delivers a biphasic release, an immediate burst to initiate the healing cascade followed by sustained delivery for ongoing regeneration.
Key Advantage: Off-the-shelf convenience with targeted angiogenesis, chemotaxis, and osteogenesis support.

Trivium integrates three synergistic components, elongated demineralized cortical fibers, trabecular cancellous chips, and demineralized bone matrix- working together to form an interconnected scaffold that supports vascularization and tissue ingrowth.
Key Advantage: PureLoc™ Fiber Technology produces longer, more consistent fibers that create a cohesive graft, enhancing biologic performance and supporting predictable clinical outcomes.
